description: Committed, deterministic declarations anchor for the differential parity runner. It is the seed companion to SEED_INVENTORY.json, not the shipped DECLARATIONS.json overlay. Every entry is a NON-SUCCESS terminal disposition (OPERATOR_ONLY or FAIL); a declaration can never manufacture PASS or SAFE_EQUIVALENT. Validated by `differential_parity.py self-check` (or `--self-check`) without executing anything.

declarations.basis: seed anchor: the live status read requires an operator-healthy running Qubit instance and a pinned reference; no execution is claimed.
declarations.operator_prerequisite: operator-held running Qubit instance (QUBIT_DIFFERENTIAL_QUBIT_URL) and a pinned Hermes/OpenClaw reference binary.

declarations.basis: seed anchor: the live voice status read needs an operator-healthy running Qubit instance and a pinned reference; recorded as a typed OPERATOR_ONLY hold, never an unproven PASS.
declarations.operator_prerequisite: operator-held running Qubit instance (QUBIT_DIFFERENTIAL_QUBIT_URL) and a pinned Hermes/OpenClaw reference; the runner never claims an unexecuted PASS.
